provenance.scope: Long-prefill paged GQA16 route (_should_use_long_prefill), scenario of refs INPUT-CHANGES (no upstream test reaches the route; the upstream case prefill-paged-bf16-gqa16 scaled to the route minimum, a coordinator decision): batch 1, total_q 8192, kv_len 16384 (128 pages of [1, 128, 128]), H 16, H_kv 1, topk 16, causal with derived q offset; grid 586 over the 586 scheduler records (M1), k2q_row_ptr [1, 129], cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_k, q_offsets and kv_lens fixed by shape arrays; k2q_qsplit_indices (payload q_idx | slot << 24 | single << 28) fixed by a shape array: the payloads of the upstream planner _build_long_prefill_plan for the upstream test generator _make_q2k (random_valid, seed 49 + 101), computed with torch (the same run reproduces the scheduler records and row pointers); page_table bounded to [0, 127] by tensor_properties (contents not fixed). Compared outputs: partial_o e4m3 [16, 8192, 16, 128], partial_scale bf16 [16, 8192, 16, 4] (one scale per 32 elements), partial_lse f32 [16, 8192, 16]; out (p10) is not written (single_split = 0 in this producer) and partial_temperature_lse is not written (return_temperature_lse 0). Coverage: every query of this scenario sees at least 65 blocks, so all 16 slots are live and every partial row is written once; every (slot, q) pair occurs exactly once among the fixed payloads.
provenance.semantics: ideal_real; split s of (q_abs, head g) is attention over the s-th selected KV block alone: O = exp2(softmax_scale_log2 q.k)-weighted mean of v over the block's visible tokens, partial_lse = ln(sum of the weights) (-inf if none), per 32-element segment partial_scale = max|O_seg|/448 and partial_o = e4m3(O * 448 / max|O_seg|); the block of (s, q_abs, h) is the CSR row of the head-h edge whose payload decodes to (s, q_abs)
